title: Attending and speaking at Haggis Ruby
partialText: thoughtbot is heading to Haggis Ruby in Glasgow on April 23-24. Come find us.

title: Enhancing job reliability with Sidekiq Pro's super fetch strategy
partialText: Explores how the core Sidekiq fetch behavior has the potential to lead to loss of job data and how the super fetch strategy provided by Sidekiq Pro can resolve this.
